properties.name: South Field Mine Pumped Storage
properties.description: A major energy transition project by PPC, transforming the South Field lignite mine into a 238 MW pumped hydro storage facility. This project repurposes the mine's excavation voids as high-capacity reservoirs, creating a 'natural battery' that stores surplus renewable energy and provides essential balance and stability to the grid.

properties.name: Amfilochia Pumped Storage
properties.description: Greece's largest energy storage investment, acting as a giant 680 MW natural battery. Developed by TERNA Energy, it pumps water to upper reservoirs during low demand and releases it to produce electricity during peak hours, stabilizing the grid.

properties.name: Argylomylos Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 390 MW utility-scale solar project by Energy Ventures 5 located in Argylomylos, Larissa. Covering 3,618 acres, it features 821,054 solar panels and 1,850 string inverters. The park connects to the 150/400 kV Terpsithea substation via a dedicated 14.7 km high-voltage line, significantly contributing to Greece's green energy transition.

properties.name: Thisavros Pumped Storage
properties.description: The largest operational pumped storage plant in Greece, featuring a 172m high dam (the tallest in the country). Located on the Nestos River, it operates with three reversible units to provide 384 MW of power, acting as a critical energy buffer for the national grid.

properties.name: North-1 Green Hydrogen
properties.description: A flagship green hydrogen production facility by Motor Oil and PPC, transforming the former Amyntaio lignite mine into a clean energy hub. This electrolysis plant will use local RES to produce green H2 for heavy industry, transport, and gas grid blending.

properties.name: Platanovrysi Pumped Storage
properties.description: A key 116 MW facility on the Nestos River, featuring the highest Roller-Compacted Concrete (RCC) dam in Europe (95m). It operates as a pumped-storage plant, generating approximately 248 GWh annually. Beyond power production, it is vital for the irrigation of the Drama and Xanthi plains and plays a crucial role in flood management and grid stability.

properties.name: Panagia-Paliampela-Marathias Solar Park
properties.description: A 350 MW mega-project developed by Z STAR (RECOM Technologies) in the Phthiotis region. Spanning the municipalities of Amfikleia-Elateia and Lokroi, it stands as one of Greece's largest solar developments.

properties.name: Asomata Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A 108 MW dam-toe power plant on the Aliakmonas River, essential for both energy and water management. Operating since 1985, it serves as the lower reservoir for the Sfikia pumped-storage system. Beyond power generation, it regulates water flow for the irrigation of the Imathia plain and contributes to the water supply of the Thessaloniki metropolitan area.

properties.name: Tsakalos Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 320 MW solar project combined with a 240 MW battery storage system in the Tsakalos area of Amfilochia. Developed by Alliance Energy, the project spans over 4,200 acres and is currently in the licensing phase. It aims to be one of Greece's largest hybrid renewable plants, though it faces local environmental discussions.

properties.name: Ladon Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A historic cornerstone of Greece's power grid, this plant utilizes the waters of the Ladon River via an impressive 8.6km long diversion tunnel. The project includes a 55m tall hollow gravity dam and produces roughly 290 GWh annually.

properties.name: Ilarion Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A strategic 160 MW multi-purpose plant on the Aliakmonas River. Featuring one of Greece's highest earth-fill dams (130m), it produces ~330 GWh annually. Beyond energy, it is critical for Thessaloniki's water supply, regional irrigation, and is notable for the historic relocation of the St. Ilarion Monastery.

properties.name: Aliveri V Power Plant
properties.description: A high-efficiency 417 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant operated by PPC (DEI) in Evia. In operation since 2013, it utilizes Alstom technology and natural gas to achieve a 58% efficiency rate, replacing older oil-fired units and providing essential power stability for the South Greek grid.

properties.name: Lavrio IV CCGT
properties.description: The first large-scale 560 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant in the Greek energy system. Located in the Thorikos area, it played a pioneering role in the transition to natural gas and remains a vital asset for the stability of the Attica power grid.

properties.name: Alexandroupolis Pilot Offshore Wind
properties.description: Greece's first pilot offshore wind farm in the Thracian Sea. Targeted for 2030, this 600 MW project will utilize massive 15 MW fixed-bottom turbines in shallow waters (<50m), unlocking the country's vast offshore wind potential.

properties.name: Evoikos Voreas Evia Wind Park
properties.description: The largest northern cluster of the colossal 500 MW Evia Wind Parks project, transitioning to Motor Oil (MORE). Located on the ridges of Central Evia, this €700M mega-project features 112 turbines across the island. Currently in intensive construction following 2024 environmental approvals.

properties.name: Thessaloniki Power Plant
properties.description: A 400 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plant located in Diavata, Thessaloniki. Fully operational since 2006, it was one of the first major private thermal power investments in Greece, providing high-efficiency power generation and supporting the stability of the national electricity grid.

properties.name: Plastiras Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A historic multi-purpose facility at the Tavropos River, featuring an 83m double-curvature arch dam. It is vital for the region, providing green energy, irrigation for the Thessalian plain, and domestic water for Karditsa. The project's unique design allowed for a massive water drop of nearly 600m, significantly enhancing efficiency while creating the iconic Lake Plastiras.

properties.name: Seli Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 309.04 MW solar project by Green Line Energy (Agrogroup) located at the 'Pilalistra' site on Mt. Vermio. This landmark installation integrates a 250 MW battery storage system, significantly enhancing grid stability.

properties.name: Revithoussa LNG Terminal
properties.description: Greece's most critical energy infrastructure for importing and storing Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG). It features 225,000 m³ of storage capacity across three tanks and a regasification rate of approximately 7 bcm/year. Recently expanded with Small Scale LNG (ssLNG) and truck loading facilities.

properties.name: Agras Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A historic 50 MW run-of-the-river plant and a cornerstone of Greece's post-war electrification. Utilizing the waters of the Edessaios River, it plays a vital role in the regional grid and the management of the Agras-Vrytton-Nissi wetland ecosystem.

properties.name: EPHYRA
properties.description: The cornerstone of Motor Oil's green hydrogen strategy in Southern Greece. Located within the Agioi Theodoroi refinery, this 50 MW electrolysis plant aims to decarbonize industrial processes, supply clean fuel for heavy transport and forms the core production unit for the TRIERES Hydrogen Valley.

properties.name: Korinthos Power Plant
properties.description: A high-efficiency 437 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant located in Agioi Theodoroi, Corinth. A joint venture between METLEN and Motor Oil, it has been operational since 2011. Boasting an efficiency rate of over 58%, it provides critical baseload stability.

properties.name: Piges Aoou Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: Greece's highest-altitude major hydroelectric project (1,350m) located on the Politses Plateau. It utilizes a unique 685m water drop and a complex system of 7 earth-fill dams to divert water from the Aoos to the Arachthos river basin. Beyond its 210 MW capacity, it significantly enhances the production of downstream plants and supports regional irrigation and tourism.

properties.name: Pournari I Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A major 300 MW hydroelectric facility on the Arachthos River, near Arta. It features one of Europe's largest earth-fill dams with a clay core, standing at 107m. The plant generates approximately 437 GWh annually and is essential for flood protection of the Arta plain and regional irrigation. It is currently being integrated into a large-scale pumped storage project. In 2026, PPC initiated the exploratory process for the conversion of the Pournari hydroelectric plant into a pumped storage station.

properties.name: Alexandroupolis FSRU
properties.description: Greece's first FSRU and a strategic energy hub for SE Europe operated by Gastrade. Connected via a 28km pipeline (24km subsea) to the national grid. Following a late-2025 upgrade, peak regasification capacity reached 136.2 GWh/day.

properties.name: Agios Nikolaos ΙΙ
properties.description: A flagship 826 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant by Metlen Energy & Metals. Operating at >63% efficiency, it features a state-of-the-art, hydrogen-ready General Electric turbine.

properties.name: Lavrio V CCGT
properties.description: A 385.2 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant in Lavrio, East Attica. Fully operational since 2006, it remains a key asset for the Greek grid's stability. The unit underwent a major combustion system upgrade (DLN 2.6+) in 2020 to further enhance its performance and environmental footprint.

properties.name: Agios Dimitrios Power Plants
properties.description: Historically the heart of Greek power generation, these iconic lignite units were permanently decommissioned in May 2026, after more than 40 years of powering the country.

properties.name: Polyfyto Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A vital 375 MW multi-purpose hydroelectric plant on the Aliakmonas River. Featuring a 112m earth-fill dam and three Francis turbines, it generates ~450 GWh annually. Its massive reservoir is crucial for Thessaloniki's water supply and regional irrigation.

properties.name: Ptolemaida V Power Plant
properties.description: Greece's largest and most advanced supercritical lignite plant (660 MW), operating since 2023. By 2028, it is scheduled to be converted into a 1,000 MW natural gas and hydrogen-ready facility, marking the end of the lignite era.

properties.name: Enerwave Thessaloniki II CCGT Power Plant
properties.description: A strategic 826 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plant planned by Enerwave (formerly Elpedison) in the Ionia industrial area. Planned to be strategically linked to the Thessaloniki FSRU, the project aims to enhance energy security in Northern Greece and the wider Balkan region through high-efficiency power generation.

properties.name: Kastraki Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: The second major step in the Acheloos River hydroelectric cascade. It features a 95m high earth-fill dam and produces ~600 GWh annually. The plant is vital for peak demand management in the national grid and provides essential irrigation for the Aitoloakarnania region, while regulating water flow downstream from the Kremasta Dam. In 2026, PPC initiated the exploratory process for the conversion of the Kastraki hydroelectric plant into a pumped storage station.

properties.name: Kafireas Wind Farm Complex
properties.description: The largest wind park complex in Greece, located in South Evia. Development by TERNA Energy and finished in 2023, it features 101 turbines and supplies massive clean energy to the grid.

properties.name: Enerwave Thisvi CCGT
properties.description: A high-efficiency 421.6 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plant located in the Industrial Area of Thisvi, Boeotia. In commercial operation since 2010, the facility has a 58% efficiency rate and utilizes seawater for its cooling system, serving as a core provider for the Greek national power grid.

properties.name: Enipeas Solar Project - South Cluster (Skopia)
properties.description: The centerpiece of the 560 MW Enipeas investment by Lightsource bp, located in Skopia, Farsala. This 400 MW cluster features ~700,000 bifacial panels and stands as one of Europe's largest solar installations. Developed with a total project investment of €395.4M, it significantly contributes to the 0.90 TWh annual production of the entire complex.

properties.name: Aiolos Evia Wind Park
properties.description: The southernmost cluster (Aiolos) of the 500 MW Evia Wind Parks complex, situated between Marmari and Karystos. It further reinforces South Evia's position as Greece's undisputed wind energy capital.

properties.name: Sitia Wind Farm (Amari Hybrid)
properties.description: An 89.1 MW wind farm cluster in Sitia. It functions as the primary renewable energy generation source for the Amari Hybrid Project, Europe's largest hybrid energy system.

properties.name: Heron II Boeotia Power Plant
properties.description: A high-efficiency 435 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plant located in Thebes, Boeotia. Operational since 2010, it represents a €235 million investment by GEK TERNA and ENGIE, providing reliable baseload power to the Greek energy system.

properties.name: Agios Georgios Wind Farm (San Tzortzis)
properties.description: An innovative 73.2 MW wind farm on the uninhabited island of Agios Georgios. Featuring 23 Vestas turbines, it is technically an onshore facility that operates with the demanding specifications of an offshore wind farm.

properties.name: Larissa Thermoelektriki CCGT
properties.description: A high-efficiency 870 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant in the Industrial Area of Larissa. The project will be linked to a future Data Center and will provide significant grid stability for Central Greece.

properties.name: Dioriga Gas FSRU
properties.description: Strategic FSRU terminal in the Saronic Gulf connected via a 150m jetty. It will offer Small Scale LNG and truck loading services. Crucially, its connecting pipeline is designed to be 100% hydrogen-ready to support the future energy transition.

properties.name: Green HiPo
properties.description: A flagship planned gigafactory in the Kozani Industrial Area. Unlike gas production sites, this is a massive manufacturing hub for High-Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane (HT-PEM) fuel cells and electrolyzers. The project is currently in a state of administrative or legal limbo.

properties.name: Tyrnavos BESS
properties.description: A significant battery energy storage system (BESS) located in the Tyrnavos region of Thessaly. Developed by V-Ridium PV1 Greece (a Greenvolt Power subsidiary), this 215MW project utilizes LFP technology to enhance grid stability and support the high concentration of renewable energy sources in Central Greece.

properties.name: Stratos I Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: The final major project of the Acheloos River cascade, this 150 MW multi-purpose plant produces ~235 GWh annually. Its 1,900m long earth-fill dam creates a reservoir that acts as a vital regulator for the irrigation of the Agrinio and Mesolongi plains, managing the water discharge from the upstream Kremasta and Kastraki stations.

properties.name: Ptolemaida Lignite Mine Orycheio Solar Farm
properties.description: The flagship 550 MW 'Phoebe' project by PPC Renewables. Fully operational since early 2026, it features ~950,000 bifacial panels across 10,000 stremmata in former lignite mines. Built by GEK TERNA with a €368M investment, it generates 1 TWh annually, powering 200,000 homes.

properties.name: Kremasta Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: The largest hydroelectric plant in Greece and a cornerstone of the national grid's peak-load management. Operational since 1966 on the Acheloos River, it features a massive 160.3m earth-fill dam and four Francis turbines, generating ~850 GWh annually while providing critical flood protection.

properties.name: Enipeas Solar Park - North Cluster (Kallithea)
properties.description: The 160 MW Northern Cluster (Kallithea) is a key component of the landmark 560 MW Enipeas project by Lightsource bp. Located in Pharsala, it features advanced bifacial panels and tracking systems and stands as one of the largest solar sub-clusters in Europe, driving Greece's energy transition.

properties.name: Thermoilektriki Komotinis CCGT
properties.description: A state-of-the-art 877 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant developed by Motor Oil and GEK TERNA. Fully operational since late 2025, it operates at >64% efficiency using a hydrogen-ready Siemens turbine, providing critical baseload stability for Northern Greece and the Balkans.

properties.name: Megalopolis Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 490 MW project by PPC Renewables (Phoebe Energeiaki) located in the former lignite mines of Megalopolis. Developed in three phases, it is designed to produce 860 GWh annually, enough to power 215,000 households. The project includes a major environmental restoration plan, featuring the planting of 174,000 native plants to rehabilitate the post-mining landscape.

properties.name: Adriani - Platanias Solar & Storage Park
properties.description: A massive 500 MW hybrid solar project by Econergy Greece, spanning 7,000 stremmata across the municipalities of Doxato and Paranesti. It features an integrated 250 MW battery storage system to ensure grid stability. With an estimated investment of over €500M, it is one of Greece's largest renewable energy hubs, aiming for completion by 2029.

properties.name: Ellinokastro Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 400 MW solar project spanning 15,512 stremmata across the Trikala and Meteora municipalities. This €216M investment represents one of Greece's largest PV developments, aimed at significantly boosting the country's renewable energy capacity by 2028.

properties.name: Mesochora Hydroelectric Plant
properties.description: A historic 161.6 MW hydroelectric project by PPC on the Acheloos River. After decades of delays, it is in its final implementation phase. It features a 150m dam and a 7.4km adduction tunnel, designed to generate ~360 GWh of clean energy annually.

properties.name: Neo Syrakio Solar Park
properties.description: A significant 368.2 MW solar project developed by Meton Energy (RWE & PPC Renewables) in Kilkis. Part of a €418M investment, it utilizes high-efficiency bifacial panels. Set for completion in 2027, it stands as one of Greece's largest renewable energy hubs.

properties.name: Western Macedonia BESS Complex
properties.description: The largest battery storage (BESS) cluster in Greece, driving the region's post-lignite transition. Developed mainly by PPC Renewables and the Eunice Group, it includes the Ptolemaida BESS (250MW), Melitis 1 (48MW), Amyntaio (50MW), and Ptolemaida 4 (50MW) stations.

properties.name: Megalopoli Storage Hub (BESS & Pumped Hydro)
properties.description: A planned dual-technology storage hub transforming the former lignite center in Peloponnese. It combines industrial LFP batteries and a 183 MW pumped hydro facility using old mine pits. It will act as a critical regulator for PPC's adjacent 490 MW solar park, storing peak daytime generation to prevent energy curtailments.

properties.name: Komotini I Power Plant
properties.description: The first major 485 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant of the Public Power Corporation (PPC) in Northern Greece. Operational since 2002, it serves as a critical energy hub for grid stability in Thrace.

properties.name: Kozani Solar Park
properties.description: A flagship 204.3 MW solar park by HELLENiQ Renewables. Operating since 2022, it features ~500,000 bifacial panels across 4,400 stremmata. Built by JUWI with a €130M investment, it generates 350 GWh annually, powering 75,000 homes and accelerating the region's decarbonization.

properties.name: Kilkis Solar Park - Kokartza
properties.description: A massive 432.6 MW solar project developed by BayWa r.e. at the Kokartza site in Kilkis. Spanning the municipalities of Paionia and Kilkis, this mega-project stands as one of the largest renewable energy plants in Greece, designed to significantly boost the national grid's green capacity upon its expected completion in 2027.

properties.name: Megalopolis V Power Plant
properties.description: A high-efficiency 811 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plant operated by PPC (DEI) in Arcadia. Fully operational since 2018, it serves as a key pillar for the energy transition in Southern Greece by replacing older lignite-fired units.

properties.name: Sofrano Evia Wind Park
properties.description: The central-south cluster (Sofrano) of the 500 MW Evia Wind Parks complex. Located in the Styra region, it aggregates power at the 'Zoodochos Pigi' substation before exporting clean energy to Attica via subsea cables.

properties.name: Chamilo-Aetolofos Solar Park
properties.description: A massive 500 MW solar project by Rytion Nearchos, spanning 13,800 stremmata across the Rodopi and Evros regions. With a €340M investment, it features ~456,000 monocrystalline panels mounted on single-axis trackers. One of the largest PV plants in SE Europe, significantly boosting Greece's green energy capacity.

properties.name: Thessaloniki FSRU
properties.description: An ambitious dual-vessel LNG terminal (FSRU and FSU) in the Thermaikos Gulf, developed by Enerwave (HELLENiQ ENERGY). It aims to supply a new 826 MW CCGT plant and boost Balkan energy security via an 11.4km pipeline network.

properties.name: Sfikia Pumped Storage
properties.description: A strategic 315 MW pumped-storage plant on the Aliakmonas River, functioning as a vital natural battery for the Greek grid. It stores surplus energy by pumping water to its upper reservoir and generating electricity during peak demand.

properties.name: Protergia CC Plant
properties.description: The first major private CCGT plant in Greece, located at the Agios Nikolaos Energy Center in Viotia. Since 2011, it has been a cornerstone of the Greek energy market, providing reliable baseload power with high operational availability.

properties.name: ARGO FSRU
properties.description: Relocated to Kritharia in the Pagasetic Gulf, this 292-meter floating unit was to be connected to the national grid via a 15 km onshore pipeline. The objective was to reinforce the 'Vertical Corridor', supplying natural gas to the Balkans and Central Europe. The project was cancelled following the rejection of the Environmental Impact Assessment by the Ministry of Environment and Energy in June 2026.

properties.name: Amari Pumped Storage (Potamoi Dam)
properties.description: A 72 MW pumped-storage hydroelectric system utilizing the existing Potamoi Dam reservoir. It stores excess wind energy from Sitia to guarantee grid stability in Crete.

properties.name: Kardia Mine Pumped Storage
properties.description: An important green transition project by PPC, converting the former Kardia lignite mine into a 294 MW energy storage hub. It utilizes the depleted mine's pits as reservoirs to store surplus renewable energy, providing critical grid stability and high-capacity storage for Northern Greece.

properties.name: Alexandroupolis CCGT Power Plant
properties.description: A strategic €400M, 840 MW Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant by PPC and DEPA. Featuring a highly efficient, hydrogen-ready (up to 50%) General Electric turbine, it operates in synergy with the local FSRU and connects directly to the 400 kV network.

properties.name: Domokos Mega BESS
properties.description: A strategic energy storage project in the Domokos hub, developed by M Star (Shanghai Electric Power & Solar Bright). Featuring an injection power of 266.4 MW and a storage capacity of 532.8 MWh, it utilizes lithium-ion (BESS) technology to stabilize the region's massive 2GW solar capacity.

properties.name: Makrerache Mesochorion wind farm
properties.description: One of the oldest wind power projects in Evia, located near Mesochoria. Developed by Rokas (Iberdrola/Principia), the complex consists of 44 turbines (Bonus & Gamesa) with a total capacity of 27.4 MW and is operating since the early 2000s.

properties.name: Prophetes Ilias (Peloponnese Wind Energy) wind farm
properties.description: A wind farm located in Achladokampos, Argolida. Developed and operated by TERNA Energy (now a member of Masdar Group), the project features 14 Vestas V90 3MW wind turbines. It was constructed and grid-connected in two phases between 2006 and 2008.

properties.name: Vysima (Vysima Vedavel) wind farm
properties.description: A 40 MW onshore wind project spanning the Florina and Amyntaio municipalities in Western Macedonia. Developed by Visima Vendavel A.E., the facility features 10 high-capacity wind turbines and integrates cutting-edge, AI-driven bird monitoring systems to minimize environmental impact near protected zones.

properties.name: Sangias wind farm
properties.description: A wind farm in the Peloponnese, located on the Saggias mountain range in Mani, now part of the HELLENiQ Renewables portfolio.

properties.name: Petalas Thyamon Oros wind farm
properties.description: Located on Mount Thyamon in Aetolia-Acarnania, the Petalas wind farm is a significant renewable energy project developed by Metlen Energy & Metals. It features 24 Vestas V100 turbines with a total capacity of 48 MW, with approved plans for a 33.6 MW expansion.

properties.name: Skotomenoi Vatheia Gonia wind farm
properties.description: A prominent wind power project located in the Desfina region of Phocis. Developed by Vector Aioliki Notias Desfinas S.A. and managed under Germany's Aquila Capital, it stands as a key component of a larger local wind complex delivering clean energy to the national grid.

properties.name: Achladotopos Gkoura Loutsa wind farm
properties.description: A wind power project located in the Municipality of Karystos, Evia. Originally developed by RF Energy and currently part of the Eren Hellas (TotalEnergies) portfolio.

properties.name: Pergade wind farm
properties.description: A major onshore wind power plant located on the Akarnanika Mountains in Aetolia-Acarnania, Western Greece. Developed by Themeli S.A., the facility features 11 advanced General Electric wind turbines.

properties.name: Gouri Meles Kiapha Verme wind farm
Psele Rache Mesokorphe wind farm
properties.description: A 33.6 MW wind farm development located on Mount Chtenias in Arcadia, Peloponnese. Developed by Aioliki Mesokorfis (Aer Soleir / Quantum Capital Group), the project features 7 high-capacity Nordex turbines and is backed by a 15-year corporate Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Amazon to supply green energy for its regional operations.

properties.name: Askio 3 wind farm
properties.description: Developed by Rokas Renewables (Iberdrola Group), Askio III features 12 Vestas V150 turbines and was notable for using innovative 'Blade Lifter' technology during construction to minimize environmental impact in the mountainous terrain.

properties.name: Prophetes Ilias Koukouras Neraidorache wind farm
Prophetes Ilias Polites Megalokorphe wind farm
properties.description: A major wind power project located at the Prophetis Ilias, Politis, and Megalokorfi hills in Sofiko, Corinthia. Owned by National Energy, the 44 MW facility enhances regional renewable capacity and connects directly to the national grid via the Agionori substation.

properties.name: Praro wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 36 MW capacity, forming part of the Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 330 MW.

properties.name: Panachaikou Ι wind farm
properties.description: Α wind power project in Greece, located on Mount Panachaiko in Achaea. Originally developed by Acciona and ENTEKA, and currently owned by Cubico Sustainable Investments.

properties.name: Xeronome wind farm
properties.description: A 36 MW wind farm located in Boeotia, Greece, featuring 8 Vestas V136 wind turbines. Owned and operated by Principia Energy—a joint venture between Italy's Enel SpA and Australia's Macquarie Asset Management—it generates an estimated 100.2 GWh of clean energy annually.

properties.name: Eresou Ypsoma Phourka wind farm
properties.description: A 36 MW wind power project located on Mount Vermio in Imathia, Greece. Developed by Energeiaki Peloponnisou (a subsidiary of TERNA Energy, which is ultimately owned by Masdar), the facility features 18 Gamesa G114 wind turbines operating at an altitude of up to 1,740 meters.

properties.name: Prophetes Ilias wind farm
properties.description: This 25.3 MW wind farm is situated on the ridge of Mount Saggias in Eastern Mani. Comprising 11 Siemens Gamesa wind turbines, it is part of HELLENiQ Renewables' broader wind cluster in Laconia.

properties.name: Askio wind farm
properties.description: An onshore wind farm located on Mount Askio in Kozani, Western Macedonia. Originally developed by ELTECH Anemos and now owned at the highest level by Motor Oil Group (MORE), the project features 9 wind turbines supplying clean energy to the national grid.

properties.name: Tsouka Skoura wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 32.4 MW capacity, forming part of the Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 330 MW

properties.name: Kasidiaris I wind farm
properties.description: Located on the Kasidiaris mountain range in Ioannina, Epirus, this project was developed by MORE Energy (Motor Oil Group). It is part of a larger 89.7 MW wind complex, marking a significant investment in Northwest Greece's renewable energy infrastructure.

properties.name: Agnadia Isoma wind farm
properties.description: A 43.2 MW wind power project located in Amyntaio, Florina, featuring 9 Nordex N149 turbines. Initially constructed and operated by MORE (Motor Oil Renewable Energy), the project's ownership was transferred to PPC Renewables following a major clean energy acquisition deal in 2026.

properties.name: Tsikna Prinia Prophetes Ilias wind farm
Hemerovigli wind farm
properties.description: Located in Kefalonia, the Imerovigli Wind Farm features a total capacity of 39 MW across 13 Vestas V90 turbines. Originally commissioned in January 2008 with 30 MW, it was later expanded in November 2018 with an additional 9 MW.

properties.name: Stournari wind farm
properties.description: A 36 MW wind project located at the Stournari site on Mount Vermio, forming part of the massive 315MW Vermiou Wind Complex. Developed by Aioliki Vermiou S.A. the site utilizes 8 advanced Nordex N-155 wind turbines.

properties.name: Makrynoros wind farm
properties.description: A 43.2 MW wind farm located on the Makrynoros mountain ridge in Nafpaktia, contributing significantly to the region's green energy capacity. Developed and operated by METLEN Energy & Metals, the facility features 12 Vestas wind turbines operating at an upgraded capacity of 3.6 MW each.

properties.name: Arkadika Meltemia wind farm
properties.description: A onshore wind farm located at the Asprovouni site in Arcadia, Peloponnese. Owned by the Eunice Energy Group, it has been powering the Greek grid for years.

properties.name: Makrelakkoma wind farm
properties.description: A wind energy project located on the Mani peninsula in Laconia, developed by HELLENiQ Renewables.

properties.name: Kryoneri (Vermiou) wind farm
properties.description: A 35 MW wind project forming part of the massive Vermio Wind Cluster in Northern Greece, developed by Aioliki Vermiou. The cluster has secured a landmark Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Amazon.

properties.name: Malia Gliata Arachnaio wind farm
properties.description: An onshore wind farm located on the Arachnaio mountain ridge in Argolis, Peloponnese. Developed and operated by Rokas Renewables (a subsidiary of the Spanish multinational Iberdrola Group), the station features 19 Gamesa G87 wind turbines delivering clean energy to the national grid.

properties.name: Karkaros wind farm
properties.description: A 36 MW wind farm located on the borders of Phocis and Boeotia, Greece. Acquired and operated by PPC Renewables, the facility features 7 Siemens Gamesa SG145 wind turbines, generating approximately 82.5 GWh of clean energy annually.

properties.name: Spelia (Enel) wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 29.9 MW capacity, forming part of the Principia Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 167.9 MW.

properties.name: Patriarches wind farm
properties.description: One of the oldest wind farms in Greece, situated in the mountainous Rodopi region. Owned at the highest level by Iberdrola (through its Greek subsidiary Rokas), it features 31 wind turbines and hosts a vital substation that serves as a critical clean energy interconnection hub in Thrace.

properties.name: Milia - Kapetanios wind farm
properties.description: A strategic 60MW wind power cluster developed by PPC Renewables in the Rhodope region (Arriana). The project features high-capacity turbines and a dedicated 20/150kV substation in Organi, significantly boosting the renewable energy capacity of Northern Greece.

properties.name: Omalies wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 15 MW capacity, forming part of the Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 330 MW.

properties.name: Giona Bourika wind farm
properties.description: The northern and largest section of the Vermio wind complex, with a capacity of 155 MW. Developed by Aioliki Vermiou (Aer Soléir & Quantum Capital Group), it is one of Greece's largest onshore wind projects.

properties.name: Timenio Oros wind farm
properties.description: A wind energy project situated on the Zavitsa ridge between Arcadia and Argolis in the Peloponnese. Developed by Arkadia - Re-Wind M.A.E. (a 100% subsidiary of PPC Renewables), the project features next-generation wind turbines and a dedicated 33/150kV substation to drive the region's green transition.

properties.name: Platanistos wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 29.9 MW capacity, forming part of the Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 330 MW.

properties.name: Maristi Mavrovouni wind farm
properties.description: An onshore wind farm located in Thebes, Boeotia, consisting of 21 Gamesa G87 wind turbines. Originally developed and operated by Eren Hellas, the project is now fully owned at the ultimate parent level by the French multinational energy giant TotalEnergies.

properties.name: Pyrgos Magoula wind farm
properties.description: Ένα βασικό υπο-έργο του μεγάλου αιολικού συμπλέγματος στο όρος Βέρμιο της βόρειας Ελλάδας, το οποίο αναπτύχθηκε από την Αιολική Βερμίου (κοινοπραξία της ΕΝΤΕΚΑ και της Aer Soléir). Η εγκατάσταση περιλαμβάνει 9 προηγμένες ανεμογεννήτριες Nordex N-155 και ανήκει στον αμερικανικό επενδυτικό όμιλο Quantum Capital Group.

properties.name: Lyrkeion Oros wind farm
properties.description: A major wind energy facility situated on the ridge of Lyrkeion Mountain, spanning the borders of Arcadia and Argolis in the Peloponnese. Originally constructed by EL.TECH. Anemos (Ellaktor Group), the project is now under the ultimate ownership of the Motor Oil Group via MORE Energy, generating electricity through 12 Vestas V112 turbines.

properties.name: Mytoula Kephali wind farm
properties.description: A 38 MW wind power plant located in the Evros regional unit, Northeastern Greece. Developed by TERNA Energy (now a subsidiary of Masdar), the facility is officially registered as the Vrachaki - Mytoula - Kefali project and is operating since 2006.

properties.name: Ptoon Pyrgos wind farm
properties.description: Located on the Mt. Ptoion ridge across Boeotia and Euboea, this 40 MW wind farm was developed by Siemens Gamesa and is owned by French energy major TotalEnergies.

properties.name: Stanes Xeropegatho Skopia (Askio II) wind farm
properties.description: Located on Mount Askio in Western Macedonia, developed by Rokas and its parent company, the Spanish energy giant Iberdrola, this facility features 9 advanced Vestas V150 turbines of 4.2MW each, optimizing efficiency and minimizing environmental footprint.

properties.name: Rachoula Paschalies wind farm
properties.description: A 44 MW wind energy complex located in the Tanagra Municipality, Boeotia, developed in three consecutive phases. Operated by Aioliki Rachoulas Dervenochorion S.A., a subsidiary of TERNA Energy (now under Masdar), the cluster features 19 wind turbines across the Rachoula - Paschalies I, II, and III sub-stations.

properties.name: Omalies wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 30 MW capacity, forming part of the Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 330 MW.

properties.name: Livadi wind farm
properties.description: A 45.2 MW wind farm located in Malesina, Phthiotis, consisting of 14 Siemens Gamesa turbines. Originally completed by EDP Renewables as its first wind asset in Greece, it was acquired in 2026 by Principia Energy, a joint venture of Enel SpA and Macquarie Asset Management.

properties.name: Kerasia (Enel) wind farm
properties.description: Wind project of 27.6 MW capacity, forming part of the Principia Kafireas Wind Farm Complex, which has a total capacity of 167.9 MW.

properties.name: Treis Vryses Kato Lakkomata wind farm
properties.name_el: Τρεις Βρυσες - Κατω Λακκωματα - Δημουλη - Μαραθακια

properties.name: Ayia Dynate wind farm
properties.description: One of the longest-standing wind projects in Kefalonia, significantly boosting the island's green energy capacity. Originally developed by EL.TECH. Anemos (Ellaktor Group) and now owned at the highest level by Motor Oil Hellas (via MORE Energy), it consists of the 27.2MW main park and a 7.3MW expansion.

properties.name: Erimia (Phthiotidas Eremia) wind farm
properties.description: A 35.4 MW wind farm located in Phthiotis, Central Greece, featuring 6 high-capacity wind turbines. Originally developed and commissioned by EDP Renewables, the project was acquired in 2026 by Principia Energy, a joint venture between Enel SpA and Macquarie Asset Management. It produces up to 71 GWh of clean electricity annually.

properties.name: West Askio wind farm
properties.description: A 40.2 MW wind farm located on Mount Askio in Kozani, Western Macedonia. Originally developed by ANEMOS RES, the project is now owned and operated by MORE (Motor Oil Renewable Energy). It consists of 10 Vestas wind turbines and has been fully operational since October 2020.

properties.name: Kasidiaris II wind farm
properties.description: The second phase of the Kasidiaris wind complex in Epirus, developed by MORE Energy (Motor Oil Group). Together with Kasidiaris I, they form a major renewable energy hub that strengthens the electrical grid of Northwest Greece.

properties.name: Tsiveri Paxivala wind farm
properties.description: An onshore wind farm located in Boeotia, Central Greece, featuring 6 wind turbines. Developed by Boiotikos Anemos and ultimately owned by EDP Renewables (EDPR), the project overcame long-standing administrative and environmental challenges related to its visibility from the historic Hosios Loukas Monastery.

properties.name: Malavria Didimon wind farm
properties.description: A 36 MW wind farm located in the Kranidi/Didyma region of Argolida, Peloponnese. Consisting of 12 Vestas V90 wind turbines, it generates approximately 60 GWh of clean energy annually. The project was developed and is operated by Aioliki Energeiaki Peloponnese S.A., under the ownership of EDF Group (EDF Renewables).

properties.name: Rache Loutsa Rache Gione wind farm
Mellia wind farm
properties.description: Located in the Voio municipality of Kozani, the Mellia Wind Farm is a 34.65 MW onshore facility developed and owned by Vendavel Energy S.A. (Papageorgiou family). Operating as an independent power producer, the project features 10 Siemens Gamesa SG132 turbines and contributes to Western Macedonia's clean energy grid.

properties.name: Derveni Mikro Derveni Sliva wind farm
Domokou Aknas solar farm
properties.description: A significant solar power plants in the Domokos region, with a capacity of 100 MW. Owned by Consortium Solar Power Systems S.A., it is part of a larger 284 MW strategic cluster. The project connects to the grid via a newly built 400kV High Voltage Substation.

properties.name: Mandria-Karamouzi solar farm
properties.description: A significant 143.6 MW solar project currently under construction on Mount Askio. Part of DEPA Commercial's larger green energy strategic investment, it occupies the Mandria Karamouzi and Kasteli sites.

properties.name: Amydaio solar farm
properties.description: A pioneering cluster of five solar farms with a total capacity of 210 MW, including the Filotas, Rodonas, Kallithea, Limnochori, and Amynteo units. Representing the first phase of Meton Energy's (RWE and PPC Renewables) strategic investment in Western Macedonia, it is supplying the national grid with clean energy from the former mine lands.

properties.name: Perdikkas 5 solar farm
properties.description: A significant cluster of three solar farms with a total capacity of 280 MW, comprising the Perdikkas, Lakkia, and Kastro units in the Amynteo region. Developed by Meton Energy (RWE and PPC Renewables), the project represents the second phase of the 940 MW portfolio, transforming former mine lands into one of the largest clean energy hubs in Southeast Europe.

properties.name: Kotyli solar farm
properties.description: A pivotal solar PV project in Kilkis developed by Meton Energy S.A. (a joint venture between RWE Renewables and PPC Renewables). It utilizes bifacial modules and tracking systems, forming part of a larger 567 MW cluster alongside the 'Neo Syrakio' project.

properties.name: Agios Christophoros solar farm
properties.description: A 65 MW solar project by PPC Renewables in the Eordaia municipality. Utilizing 120,000 bifacial panels, it generates approximately 100 GWh of clean energy annually.

properties.name: Exoche 7 solar farm
properties.description: An 80 MW solar park located in the former lignite mines of Ptolemaida, near the village of Exochi. Developed by PPC Renewables using bifacial panels, it is part of a larger 171 MW cluster (alongside Exochi 8 and Kardia 1)

properties.name: Kleithi solar farm
properties.description: A pioneering cluster of five solar farms with a total capacity of 210 MW, including the Filotas, Rodonas, Kallithea, Limnochori, and Amynteo units. Representing the first phase of Meton Energy's (RWE and PPC Renewables) strategic investment in Western Macedonia, it is supplying the national grid with clean energy from the former mine lands.

properties.name: Solar Arrow solar farm
properties.description: An important renewable energy project, developed by PPC Renewables. Located in the exhausted lignite mines of the Western Macedonia Lignite Center (LKDM), this 200 MW solar park operates alongside two smaller parks to form a massive 230 MW green energy complex.

properties.name: Delphini solar farm
properties.description: A solar project located in Prosotsani, Drama, developed by Cero Generation (Macquarie Asset Management). It is the first large-scale PV park in Greece to operate under a private Corporate PPA (with Axpo) without state subsidies.

properties.name: Kouphopetra Mandria solar farm
properties.description: A large solar clusters in Western Macedonia, developed by North Solar S.A. (Kiefer Group). Located on Mount Askio, the project consists of four interconnected stations that significantly bolster Greece's renewable energy capacity.

properties.name: Loutsa solar farm
properties.description: A utility-scale solar park located in Boeotia, central Greece. Developed by Helioelxis Energy and constructed by Metlen, the project features a 150kV high-voltage connection to ensure efficient grid integration.

properties.name: Amydaio Orycheio solar farm
properties.description: A flagship 450 MW solar project developed by Meton Energy (a joint venture between RWE and PPC Renewables) within the boundaries of the former Amynteo lignite mine. As the largest single solar park in the overall 940 MW portfolio, it utilizes bifacial panel technology and plays a pivotal role in the green transition and decarbonization of Western Macedonia.

properties.name: Martino solar farm (Greece)
properties.description: A solar development with a total capacity of 66.5 MW (Martino 1: 41.6 MW, Martino 2: 24.9 MW) located in the Municipality of Lokroi. Part of the Metlen Energy & Metals portfolio following its acquisition from Egnatia Group, the project utilizes advanced tracking systems to maximize energy yield and is expected to reach commercial operation by 2026.

properties.name: Vrysia solar farm
properties.description: The Vrysia Solar Park in Farsala, with a nominal capacity of 94.9 MW, is a strategic investment by DEPA Commercial (through its subsidiary North Solar 1).

properties.name: Tsoukari solar farm
properties.description: The second component of DEPA Commercial's solar cluster on Mount Askio. This 55.7 MW project, located at the Tsoukari and Karamouzi sites, complements the neighboring Koufopetra station, creating a combined green energy hub that exceeds 200 MW in total capacity.

properties.name: Dimou Thivaion solar farm
properties.description: A significant solar development in the Thiva region, part of National Energy's Greek portfolio. The Koukouvagia project utilizes bifacial panel technology and was constructed by Sunel Group, significantly enhancing the renewable energy capacity of the Boeotia region.

properties.name: Pente Adelphia (Juwi Hellas) solar farm
properties.description: A 100 MW solar photovoltaic project in the Trikokkia area of Deskati Municipality, developed by JUWI Hellas.

properties.name: Perasma solar farm
properties.description: An important renewable project in Western Macedonia, symbolizing the region's transition into the green energy era. Developed by Principia (a Joint Venture of Enel and Macquarie), the cluster consists of 7 solar parks across the Aetovouni, Sideras, Mavrodendri, and Perasma areas.

properties.name: Exoche 8 solar farm
properties.description: A 75 MW photovoltaic station covering approximately 196 hectares within the Western Macedonia lignite hub, near the Akrini settlement.

properties.name: Orycheio Lakkias solar farm
properties.description: A significant cluster of three solar farms with a total capacity of 280 MW, comprising the Perdikkas, Lakkia, and Kastro units in the Amynteo region. Developed by Meton Energy (RWE and PPC Renewables), the project represents the second phase of the 940 MW portfolio, transforming former mine lands into one of the largest clean energy hubs in Southeast Europe.

properties.name: Rodonas solar farm
properties.description: A pioneering cluster of five solar farms with a total capacity of 210 MW, including the Filotas, Rodonas, Kallithea, Limnochori, and Amynteo units. Representing the first phase of Meton Energy's (RWE and PPC Renewables) strategic investment in Western Macedonia, it is supplying the national grid with clean energy from the former mine lands.

properties.name: Makare Kipos solar farm
properties.description: A significant solar power plant located in Domokos, Phthiotis. Originally developed by Hive Energy and now under Juwi Hellas, the project is a vital component of Greece's renewable energy capacity expansion.

properties.name: Akrine solar farm
properties.description: An 80 MW solar park developed by PPC Renewables in the former lignite mines of Kozani.

properties.name: Alamana - Vampa - Potamakia solar farm
properties.description: A solar energy complex located in Anthili, Fthiotida, consisting of the Vamba, Potamakia, and Alamana sub-stations. Developed by National Energy, the cluster utilizes bifacial panels and advanced tracking systems to maximize output, feeding green energy directly into the HTS high-voltage grid.

properties.name: Kozani (ELPE) solar farm
properties.description: A major RES project consisting of 18 individual photovoltaic parks operating as a single unit with a capacity of 204.23 MW. It was completed in 2022 by HELLENiQ Renewables, representing a €130 million investment.

properties.name: Vouzi-Dilopho solar farm
properties.description: A large solar park (200 MW) spanning the areas of Vouzi and Dilofo in Farsala. Developed by ELZET SOLAR (a Greenvolt subsidiary), the project is a key pillar of the strategic Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Amazon for the supply of green energy.

properties.name: Xirokabi solar farm
properties.description: A major 70 MW solar project by TotalEnergies located in the Eurotas municipality, Laconia. Featuring 123,900 bifacial panels, it generates 120 GWh of green energy annually.

properties.name: Avlaki Hydroelectric Power Plant
properties.description: A green energy project by TERNA Energy located on the Acheloos River. With an installed capacity of 83.6 MW, it is designed to produce approximately 250 GWh of clean energy annually while providing crucial flood protection for the region.

properties.name: Flampouro Pumped Storage
properties.description: A pumped storage hydropower plant in Western Macedonia, that will utilize the Ilarionas reservoir as its lower basin. Developed by Aliakmonas 1, the project will act as a massive 'natural battery', recycling water between two reservoirs to balance the national grid and support R.E.S. integration.

properties.name: Trani Rachi Pumped Storage
properties.description: One of the most significant planned pumped storage hydro projects in Greece, located on the borders of Grevena and Kozani. Developed by Pindos Energeiaki, it involves the construction of an upper reservoir at Trani Rachi and a lower reservoir near the Ilarion dam, providing critical storage capacity for the power grid.
